Name: ECoalifier
Author: Riyango
Description:
[size=5][b][color=#00ffff]ECoalifier[/color][/b] :

[/size][size=4]This adds a new machine that can convert battery packs to coals .[/size]

[size=5][color=#00ffff]Defaults[/color] :
[/size][size=4]- Recipe for the machine : 5 Batteries + 1 Diamond + 1 Prismatic Shard + 10 Iron Bars + 20 Coals + 50 Woods
- Machine Output : 1 Battery -> 5 coals
- Unlocks at : Level 5 Mining

[/size][size=5][color=#00ffff]Configuration[/color] :
[/size]- [size=3]Most of the things can be configured using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GMCM[/url] or editing the config file once it is generated upon first launch .
- 2 versions (differ by cosmetic only) are available . One is vanilla and one is a toned down version to use with recolors like [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5255]Earthy[/url] .
- i18n files are provided and anyone can translate if they want .﻿[/size]

[size=5][color=#00ffff]Compatibility [/color]:
[/size][size=3]Works with modified Hoppers from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/24332]DaLionheart[/url] for automation .
Haven't tested with automate but should work . Report if doesn't .
[/size]
[size=5][color=#00ffff]Credits[/color] :[/size]
[size=3]The assets are recolored versions of charcoal kilns from the mod [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/18986]Quality Charcoal Kilns[/url] by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/tikamin557?gameId=1303]tikamin557[/url] with their permission .
[/size]
